messages.subject: WITHOUT PREJUDICE - Hartnell and Bracken Group plc
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Bartlett,

We act for Bracken Group plc. Please find attached a without prejudice letter, written as part of a protected conversation under s.111A ERA 1996, setting out terms on which the Company is prepared to settle.

The offer (£180,000 inclusive, plus the ancillary terms set out) is open for 14 days. We'd be glad to discuss by telephone.

Yours sincerely,
Tom Gallagher

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP
T: 020 7946 0021

messages.subject: RE: WITHOUT PREJUDICE - Hartnell and Bracken Group plc
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Gallagher,

Thank you. I have taken instructions. My client does not consider £180,000 reflects the strength of the protected-disclosure and age claims, nor the value of his 12-month notice entitlement. Our counter is £290,000 inclusive, a 12-month reference period for PMI, a contribution of £2,000 plus VAT to costs, and removal of the restrictive covenants in their entirety.

I think there is a deal to be done but we are some way apart. Shall we speak on Thursday?

Eleanor Bartlett

Eleanor Bartlett
Partner | Employment
Ashworth Quinn LLP
DX 233 Birmingham

messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Bartlett,

Thank you for the call earlier. To confirm where we landed in principle, subject to client approval and contract: a figure in the £240-250k range, six months' PMI, £1,500 plus VAT to costs, and a reduction (not removal) of the covenants to nine months. I'll revert with a firm position once I've taken instructions.

Kind regards,
Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP
T: 020 7946 0021
